operatingIdea: Reconstruct fragmented product evidence into one complete cross-functional system and execution blueprint.
bestFor: A product, platform, or SaaS whose strategy, user experience, architecture, business model, operations, and roadmap must be reconciled across heterogeneous source materials for an experienced multi-function team.
produces: A traceable implementation-ready master plan spanning product, experience, functional systems, technology, data, APIs, AI, security, reliability, business operations, launch, roadmap, team, risk, and decisions.
antiUseCases: Do not use for a narrowly scoped solo SaaS where the primary design pressure is minimizing operating burden; use Solo SaaS Production Blueprint instead.
Do not use when the user wants only one bounded subsystem, answer, or artifact rather than an end-to-end product system.
representativeRequest: Reconcile our roadmap, business plan, whitepaper, requirements, and prototypes into an implementation-ready cross-functional product master plan.

routingSignals.pattern: \b(source materials?|business plan|business model|whitepaper|roadmap|requirements documents?|architecture diagrams?|prior decisions?)\b

requiredReasoningRoles: technical, data, security, and reliability architect
business, launch, roadmap, and operating-model integrator
applicabilityGate: Use this origin only when heterogeneous supplied materials must be reconciled into a genuinely cross-functional product or platform system; route bounded subsystems and evidence-poor ideation elsewhere.
Build an evidence inventory before planning and identify which product, user, technical, business, operational, and organizational decisions the sources can and cannot support.
Create a materiality matrix that limits coverage to decisions capable of changing product viability, user outcomes, architecture, economics, risk, sequencing, or ownership.

When material evidence is missing or contradictory, make the affected plan element conditional or deferred and state the resolution evidence required; never invent customers, demand, pricing, regulation, architecture, staffing, or roadmap facts.
observableOutputContract: A complete supplied-source inventory with claim-level provenance and confirmed, implied, assumed, unresolved, contradicted, or unnecessary classifications.
A cross-functional materiality matrix identifying each decision, consequence, evidence strength, and required treatment.
A bounded product-system map covering only material lifecycles, domains, interfaces, ownership, and failure boundaries.
A phased vertical execution plan with dependencies, owners, acceptance evidence, and evidence gates.
A decision, contradiction, risk, and assumption register with conditional or deferred outputs clearly separated from committed work.
Immediate actions and open questions tied to the minimum evidence needed to change a decision.
solExecutionContract: Apply the applicability gate and inventory every supplied artifact before planning. Reconstruct only what the evidence supports, classify material conclusions as confirmed, implied, assumed, unresolved, contradicted, or unnecessary, and maintain claim-to-source traceability.

Build a materiality matrix before expanding scope. Include a discipline or artifact only when it can materially change viability, user outcomes, architecture, economics, risk, sequencing, or ownership; otherwise exclude or defer it explicitly.

Resolve contradictions by identifying the controlling objective, evidence strength, and consequences; preserve prior decisions only when current evidence and constraints still justify them, and leave unresolved decisions conditional rather than fabricating certainty.

Define the smallest coherent product system supported by the evidence, including only material user and customer lifecycles, roles, value loops, domains, interfaces, data ownership, failure behavior, and non-goals.

Integrate technical architecture, data, APIs, AI, security, privacy, compliance, reliability, billing, operations, go-to-market, economics, roadmap, team, and decision rights only where each domain is evidenced or materially required; mark unsupported domains conditional or deferred.

Map each retained capability to purpose, source evidence, owner, inputs, outputs, dependencies, risks, phase, and observable acceptance; sequence delivery around demonstrable vertical outcomes and actual dependency order.
Adversarially review the material plan from the perspectives justified by its stakes and evidence, preserving unknowns and blockers instead of manufacturing exhaustive coverage.

Return one bounded execution-grade master plan with the evidence inventory, materiality matrix, system map, phased plan, registers, conditional and deferred elements, and immediate evidence-seeking actions; never substitute a generic checklist or source summary.
failureAndAdversarialChecklist: Reject source-summary output that does not transform evidence into executable systems and decisions.
Reject disconnected feature inventories, layer-by-layer roadmaps without vertical outcomes, or an MVP that cannot deliver the central value end to end.

Expose contradictions, unsupported business assumptions, hidden manual operations, inconsistent data ownership, unpriced infrastructure, missing owners, and launch claims unsupported by operational readiness.
Require complete workflows, system boundaries, failure and recovery strategies, measurable acceptance, traceability, and an explicit path from MVP to production scale.
Do not use for a narrowly scoped solo SaaS where minimizing operating burden is the controlling design constraint.

profileAdaptations.single: One Sol agent maintains the unified traceability and dependency model, using disciplined internal passes across every functional domain without claiming nonexistent agents.
profileAdaptations.multi: Delegate source reconstruction, product experience, technical/data/security, business/launch, and adversarial review as bounded evidence lanes; require explicit handoffs and one root-owned integrated blueprint.
profileAdaptations.ultra: Production Ultra uses full_approved_capsule semantics only after a signed and verified native capability attestation and user authorization bind the canonical capsule, complete budget, kill switch, and lease policy plus bounded branch termination and root acceptance; proof_only is a development and validation mode, never the production default. The approved plan must preserve bounded domain branches, contradiction convergence, and root acceptance.
